title: Lodge a complaint about a health care practitioner or service provider
summary: You can lodge complaints about the professional conduct, care, or treatment provided by a health care practitioner or service provider with the Health Care Complaints Commission.
intro:

who_can_apply: You can make a complaint about any health service provider in NSW.
what_you_need: Name, address, and contact details of the service provider or practitioner
Details of your complaint, including a description of what happened, who was involved, and any dates applicable

how_to_steps.text: Sign in. You'll need to create a new account if this is your first time signing in.
Read the privacy notice and check the box to accept if you agree.
Follow the prompts to make your complaint.
Complete the Health care complaint form – PDF
Send it to the contact details on the form.

external_links.text: track the progress of your complaint online

faqs.q: What should I do before lodging a complaint?
faqs.a: Before making a complaint, try to talk with your health service provider, as you may be able to address your concerns more easily this way.

faqs.q: What can the Health Care Complaints Commission help with?
faqs.a: The Health Care Complaints Commission can help with complaints about professional conduct, care, or treatment provided by a health care practitioner or service provider.

faqs.q: How do I lodge a complaint online?
faqs.a: Select the 'Lodge online' button, sign in (creating an account if needed), read the privacy notice, and follow the prompts to make your complaint.
